name: Cobra Stretch

instructions.description: Lie face down with hands under the shoulders and legs relaxed behind you.
Gently draw the shoulder blades back and begin lifting the chest using back muscles first.
Press lightly into the hands only as much as needed while keeping the pelvis in contact with the floor.
Lower the chest slowly back down and rest.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a low to moderate extension range that feels comfortable.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Stay on the forearms for a gentler back extension.

commentsNotes: Avoid pushing into sharp lower-back discomfort.
Keep the neck long rather than throwing the head back.
